title: Herbal Gooey Kenyan Oatmeal Stew
description: A comforting, lowfat Kenyan stew that blends savory herbs with silky oats for a midnight craving that feels like home.

ingredients.name: herb blend
ingredients.notes: thyme, bay leaf, ground cardamom, minced ginger

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a medium pot over medium heat.
Add the diced carrot and potato, sautéing for 3–4 minutes until they start to soften.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for another 2 minutes, allowing it to caramelize slightly.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring to a gentle boil.
Add the herb blend, reduce heat, and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes.
Stir in the rolled oats, reduce heat to low, and cover; cook for 6–8 minutes until oats are soft and the stew thickens.
Fold in the fresh spinach, allowing it to wilt in 1–2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot.
